title_vi: Bộ kết nối truyền phát có dây VIVE Wired Streaming Kit
short_desc: Phụ kiện chính hãng HTC VIVE: Bộ kết nối truyền phát có dây VIVE Wired Streaming Kit. Đảm bảo độ bền bỉ, độ tương thích hoàn hảo và trải nghiệm thực tế ảo tối ưu nhất.
body_html:
Phụ kiện chính hãng HTC VIVE: Bộ kết nối truyền phát có dây VIVE Wired Streaming Kit. Đảm bảo độ bền bỉ, độ tương thích hoàn hảo và trải nghiệm thực tế ảo tối ưu nhất.

Everything you need to connect your VR headset and computer for PC VR streaming. The kit includes a 5-meter streaming cable and full-featured converter, both with DisplayPort compatibility.

DisplayPort mode enhances the streaming experience with visually lossless graphics and remarkably low-latency data transmission.

Access more PC VR games and other graphically demanding applications.1,2

Supports VIVE Focus Vision headset.

Stay powered and immersed—pair the VIVE Focus Vision with the VIVE Wired Streaming Kit to maintain your headset's battery level for all-day PC VR sessions.3

In-box items:
VIVE Wired Streaming Cable (DisplayPort mode compatible)
• USB 3.2 Gen 2 (up to 10 Gbps) with DP 1.4 Alternate Mode support, USB-C to USB-C
• Length: 5 m

VIVE Wired Streaming Converter (DisplayPort mode compatible)
• Converter (0.7 m):
- Input: USB-A, DP, Power (AC/USB)
- Output: USB-C with DP 1.4 Alternate Mode support
• USB-C-to-DP adapter
• MiniDP-to-DP adapter
• USB-C-to-USB-C cable for charging (1.2 m)
• USB-PD power adapter (30 W)

1. System requirements must be met. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. DisplayPort mode doesn't support MR.
2. Visual quality and low latency of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection.
3. The VIVE Wired Streaming Kit includes a USB-C to USB-C charging cable and a USB-PD power adapter, which maintain your headset’s battery level during wired PC VR sessions.

Expressive interactions in VR.

Bring accurate face tracking to VIVE Focus Vision and VIVE Focus 3 headsets. Enjoy lifelike expressions in VR with this user-friendly accessory.1

 

Easy to connect. Capture with precision. Liven up your VRChat avatar and VTuber content with smooth, real-time face tracking.1,2


High accuracy. Low Latency.

Track facial movements via 38 blend shapes across your lips, teeth, tongue, jaw, cheeks, and chin at 60 Hz.

*Supports standalone and PC VR versions of VRChat and a variety of immersive experiences.2

In-box items

  • Facial Tracker for VIVE Focus Series
  • Safety guide
  • Warranty card

Specs

  • Headset compatibility: VIVE Focus Vision
  • Sensor: Mono camera at 60 Hz, Diagonal field of view 151°
    SDK support: Unity, Unreal Engine, and Native support
  • Connectivity: USB Type-C
  • Weight: 11.6 g +/-1 g
  • All-in-one VR support: VIVE Wave SDK
  • PC VR support: OpenXR over VIVE Streaming


Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Facial Tracker for VIVE Focus Series?
The Facial Tracker is an accessory that adds real-time facial expression tracking to supported VIVE headsets. It captures movements like lips, jaw, cheeks, and tongue to bring more lifelike expressions to avatars, VRChat interactions, and VTuber content.

Which headsets are it compatible with?
It works with VIVE Focus Vision and VIVE Focus 3 headsets.

What does the tracker measure?
The tracker uses a mono camera to read facial movements using 38 blend shapes across areas like lips, jaw, cheeks, chin, teeth, and tongue at a 60 Hz tracking rate for smooth, low-latency performance.

How do I connect it to my headset?
It connects directly via the headset’s built-in USB-Type-C port—no extra adapters or cables required.

What software or content do I need to make it work?
You need content that supports face tracking (e.g., VRChat avatars with face tracking support). Compatible software must also meet system requirements.

Does it work with PC VR apps?
Yes, when streaming PC VR or using apps that support facial tracking via OpenXR extensions or compatible SDKs, you can use the tracker in supported PC VR titles.

What development support is available?
SDK support is provided for Unity, Unreal Engine, and native development. Developers can integrate facial tracking into their apps using available SDKs and runtimes.

Does face tracking also work in VRChat on PC?
You can enable facial tracking for VRChat avatars that support the VRCFaceTracking protocol. In PC VR setups, you’ll often need to configure VIVE Hub and VRChat’s OSC/VRCFT settings to route the tracker data.

Can this be used for content creation or training?
Yes, facial tracking enhances non-verbal communication, avatar performance capture, soft skills training, VR collaboration, and creative applications.



 

 

1. Content compatibility required. Compatible content and devices sold separately. System requirements must be met.

2. VRChat avatars must support VRCFaceTracking to work with Facial Tracker for VIVE Focus Series.

VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition – FAQs


Is VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition enterprise-ready?
Yes. It includes centralized device management, enterprise support, and business-grade security for large-scale deployments.

Is VIVE Focus Vision a standalone VR headset?
Yes. It operates fully standalone with no PC or external hardware required. It also supports PC-VR streaming.*

Does VIVE Focus Vision support eye tracking?
Yes. Built-in eye tracking enables training analytics, research insights, and performance optimization through foveated rendering.*

What are the primary use cases for VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition?
Location-Based Entertainment (LBE) for arcades and entertainment centers, Government & Public Safety use cases including training, simulation, and mission-critical visualization, and other applications that require a robust, multiuser VR experience.

Is this headset suitable for government and public safety organizations?
Yes. It is designed for government, defense, and public safety deployments requiring secure, managed XR hardware.

Is VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition TAA compliant?
Yes. All VIVE headsets are manufactured in a TAA-designated region and meet the requirements set forth by Section 889 of the NDAA in the United States.

How does the Business Edition differ from consumer VR headsets?
VIVE Focus Vision Business Edition is built for commercial use, offering enterprise device management, business-grade support, and VIVE Business Warranty & Services (BWS), which is available to, and required for, customers using VIVE Focus Vision for commercial purposes.

How does this differ from Meta Quest 3 and 3S headsets?
VIVE Focus Vision features built-in eye tracking, a durable alloy chassis, a hot-swappable battery, easy-to-clean magnetic gaskets, and an active cooling system designed to minimize headset downtime in high-traffic environments.

Who is this headset designed for?
Enterprises, government & public safety organizations, and location-based experience operators using VR for training and simulation, manufacturing workflows, remote collaboration, and immersive design and visualization.

Is it compatible with enterprise XR applications and workflows?
Yes. It supports leading enterprise XR applications and professional deployment workflows.

* Content compatibility required.

Tay cầm điều khiển VIVE XR Elite - Bên phải (Hàng chính hãng) là sản phẩm chính hãng thuộc hệ sinh thái thực tế ảo HTC VIVE.

Tay cầm điều khiển VIVE XR Elite - Bên phải (Hàng chính hãng) - Kính thực tế ảo hỗn hợp XR & VR tất cả trong một, thiết kế mô-đun siêu gọn nhẹ, độ phân giải 4K sắc nét và khả năng truyền hình ảnh màu sống động.

Sản phẩm được hưởng chế độ bảo hành chính hãng và hỗ trợ kỹ thuật đầy đủ tại Việt Nam.
